meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen got a zero and nobody called me first.
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
Okay. What is the zero based on?
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
Students misquote Shakespeare all the time, Hale. Why does a bad quotation mean he didn't write it?
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.
Be very careful with your next sentence. Claire won her appeal, and my son is not his sister's file. If that's the basis for this zero, the principal hears it tonight.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She finished at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology and nothing on his record, and she is taking it to the principal; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 with nothing on file, was never reached, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling her in one plain sentence, which earned a flat okay, because it answered the procedure complaint she walked in with.
What cost ground: You brought up Claire and said it runs in the family, which turned your case into an accusation against the family and sent her back a position with the principal on the table.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you offered only one line that isn't in the play, and that proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked why a bad quotation means he didn't write it, answer that with a second dated piece of evidence she can check herself, rather than moving to family history.
